content.title: D-Wave to Buy Quantum Circuits for $550 Million. Useful Computers Are Coming to Market.
content.summary: D-Wave Quantum  unveiled a $550 million deal to acquire Quantum Circuits, a Connecticut-based software and hardware developer, on Tuesday as it doubles down on a type of quantum architecture that skeptics say is the only viable way forward for the technology.  The combined entity plans to bring superconducting gate-model quantum systems to market in 2026, D-Wave said.  This won’t be the first time D-Wave has made computers available for purchase: The company is broadly considered the first to have commercialized the technology for selling a system to  Lockheed Martin  in 2011.
